# EDC Connector UI Examples - Next.js

This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/) project bootstrapped to showcase the composability of the EDC Connector UI components for React.

## Getting Started

First, spin up a development connector:

```bash
docker compose up
```

Seed assets in the development connector:

```bash
yarn seed
```

Then run the development server:

```bash
yarn dev
```

Finally, open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.
